//: Saving and loading (13 §9, 12 §10.7). `ui:pause` opens the first to save the game under a name; the title's Load and the pause menu's Load open the second, the list of `app.saves`, newest first, each with its name, its summary and when it was written, and greyed where it was made with other mods (`state` is `changed`: it loads, and what differs is told) or cannot be read (`broken`). A profile names the third for the role `notice`: the application opens it over the play screen with what a load had to say.
title: Save

input.label: Name
input.tip: Left empty, the character's name. A save of the same name is replaced.

list.item: {if it.state == 'enabled' then it.name else ''}<dim>{if it.state == 'enabled' then '' else it.name}  {it.description}{if it.state == 'changed' then '  (other mods)' else ''}{if it.state == 'broken' then '  (cannot be read)' else ''}</>
list.tip: Enter carries the game on from there.

tooltip.value: Up and Down choose, Enter loads, Esc goes back.
